extracted.intended_audience: public health communication planners, program managers, and health educators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for planning, developing, pretesting, implementing, and evaluating public health/health communication programs and materials, including research methods and planning forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 1: Planning and Strategy Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage 1: Planning and Strategy Development (planning steps and strategy formulation for health communication programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning Steps
rubrics_metrics.description: Planning Steps (detailed sequence of actions for planning health communication interventions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 2: Developing and Pretesting Concepts, Messages, and Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage 2: Developing and Pretesting Concepts, Messages, and Materials (process for creating and testing campaign concepts, messages, and materials prior to implementation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Steps in Developing and Pretesting Messages and Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps in Developing and Pretesting Messages and Materials (explicit stepwise guidance on developing and pretesting communications content).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quasi-Quantitative Research Methods: Pretesting Messages and Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Quasi-Quantitative Research Methods: Pretesting Messages and Materials (methods that combine qualitative insights with limited quantitative measures for pretesting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualitative Research Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualitative Research Methods (use of focus groups, in-depth interviews, and other qualitative approaches to inform message development and evaluation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantitative Research Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantitative Research Methods (surveys and other quantitative designs for measuring audience characteristics, exposure, and outcomes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 3: Implementing the Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage 3: Implementing the Program (operationalizing the communication strategy and materials in the field).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 3: Implementing the Program Forms and Samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage 3: Implementing the Program Forms and Samples (practical forms and sample templates to support implementation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage 4: Assessing Effectiveness and Making Refinements
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage 4: Assessing Effectiveness and Making Refinements (monitoring, evaluation, and iterative improvement of communication programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting Outcome Evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting Outcome Evaluation (approaches and steps for measuring program outcomes and impacts).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1. Determine What Information the Evaluation Must Provide
rubrics_metrics.description: 1. Determine What Information the Evaluation Must Provide (defining evaluation purpose and questions — what the evaluation should tell stakeholders).

rubrics_metrics.name: 2. Define the Data You Need to Collect
rubrics_metrics.description: 2. Define the Data You Need to Collect (specifying indicators, variables, and the kinds of data required to answer evaluation questions).

rubrics_metrics.name: 3. Decide on Data Collection Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: 3. Decide on Data Collection Methods (selection of appropriate methods to gather the defined data).

rubrics_metrics.name: 4. Develop and Pretest Data Collection Instruments
rubrics_metrics.description: 4. Develop and Pretest Data Collection Instruments (creating and piloting surveys, interview guides, and other instruments).

rubrics_metrics.name: 5. Collect Data
rubrics_metrics.description: 5. Collect Data (procedures and standards for fielding data collection activities).

rubrics_metrics.name: 6. Process Data
rubrics_metrics.description: 6. Process Data (data cleaning, coding, and management prior to analysis).

rubrics_metrics.name: 7. Analyze the Data to Answer the Evaluation Questions
rubrics_metrics.description: 7. Analyze the Data to Answer the Evaluation Questions (selecting analytical approaches and interpreting results to address the evaluation questions).

rubrics_metrics.name: 8. Write an Evaluation Report
rubrics_metrics.description: 8. Write an Evaluation Report (documenting methods, findings, conclusions, and recommendations for stakeholders).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refining Your Health Communication Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Refining Your Health Communication Program (using evaluation and monitoring findings to adjust strategy, messages, and implementation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix A: Communication Planning Forms and Samples
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A: Communication Planning Forms and Samples (templates and sample forms to support planning, pretesting, implementation, and evaluation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix B: Selected Planning Frameworks, Social Science Theories, and Models of Change
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix B: Selected Planning Frameworks, Social Science Theories, and Models of Change (theoretical foundations and frameworks to guide program design and expected mechanisms of change).

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning Systems/Frameworks
rubrics_metrics.description: Planning Systems/Frameworks (specific planning systems and frameworks to structure communication program development).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selected Social Science Theories, Models, and Constructs
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected Social Science Theories, Models, and Constructs (behavioural and social theories informing message and intervention design).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix C: Information Sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix C: Information Sources (references and sources for further data, evidence, and background information).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication Research Methods (Additional/Other)
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional Research Methods and steps (including 'Additional Research Methods' and other methods beyond the primary categories).
